title: 第584章 成肥羊了四位天人境同时前来练体的疯子第583章 炼神秘法冥焰逃脱千面幻形术
slug: 从基础刀法开始肝熟练度
lines: 比赛一开始就进入了火爆的对攻战，两人没有试探，没有犹豫，簸箕大的拳头玩命的往对方的脑袋和身体上招呼。
但是，林浩管不了那么多了，毕竟，如今先将修为提升上去的话，才是正事。
“你的直属长官，另有其人，我不是。
分属不同。
有什么事，你其实？”
次席渐渐迷起了眼睛，看你跟防贼一样。
这种甲胄是完全仿制大明南军的，就连盔甲都是范阳笠式样，只是材质为竹子或木片，且外层刷了油。
在第八战区各大战场之上，京都部队用扩音器毫不停歇的广播着。
林浩发现那光影十分的模糊，而且其灵魂气息看起来十分的强悍。
“谁说不是，幸好我们带了不少地精炮，此地岩层顶部也在四阶异能枪的射程之内，导致翼族人，飞行骑士，没有多大威胁，否则战局如何还真不好说。”
任为民眉头紧锁，一双虎目，死死注视着整个战场。
噗噗声中，大片草坪被轰击的土石飞溅，密密麻麻的坑洞接连呈现着。
他端着茶，坐在后厅之中，思绪却是一下子飞到了这东阳城沿途的布局之中，他发现这东阳城虽然不大，而且街道也仅仅一条，但布局严整，且官署与普通百姓住所之地，商铺分开，而且以议事大会堂为中轴线，对称布局。
超出了上帝视角的范围，也超出了你手动遥控分身的范围，甚至看守你们这些军官的特殊士兵都带有多重反隐形设备。
若是用寻常手段是不可能盗听后续会议讨论的计划详情的。
姚灵断断继继的哭泣，她已经不是吸血鬼了，她的身体承受不了这种粗暴，好痛，真的好痛，她恨死了驭鬼，总有一天她要亲手杀了他。
那声响如同崩炸的山谷，随着声响的崩炸的则是数百名一同跃入高空，随后如同炮弹一般准确落在近卫军军旅中，那一重又一重的重击，此起彼伏的跃起。
云泽来不及还给她，清让已经起身往外走，云泽握着手里的金钗，明白她的意思，她将这样贵重的东西托付给他，她不回头看他一眼，是因为希望他无论如何都要活到与她重逢。
过了好一会儿，才有武术生面面相觑之余，止不住笑意，警惕与敌意尽皆褪去，只剩纯粹的战意。
等到这盘古大神的元神散了许久之后，众人这时才慢慢的回过神来。
术法之力则要相对简单许多，内悟体心似乎玄妙实际上就是理论加实践的路子。
这也就是为什么左殷总是嚷嚷着实验，切片研究的原因。
“大哥，你为何这么不希望我去夜银，那里毕竟是七哥的食邑。”
比起其他的地方，那里至少还有她可以信任依靠的。
她心里清楚的很，那些失踪的人，都已经死了，再也找不回来了。
战争就好像是压跷跷板一样，一边高了，另一边就要低了。
一边高兴了，令一边就不高兴了。
content_en:
The game entered into a heated battle at the beginning. The two did not test or hesitate. Their fists as big as dustpans hit each other's head and body desperately.
However, Lin Hao couldn't control that much. After all, it was business to improve his cultivation first.
"There is someone else who is your direct commander, and I am not.
They belong to different categories.
What's the matter with you actually? "
The second seat gradually became fascinated, looking at you as if you were on guard against a thief.
This kind of armor is a complete imitation of the Ming Dynasty's Southern Army. Even the armor is in the style of Fan Yangli, but it is made of bamboo or wood chips and the outer layer is oiled.
On the major battlefields in the Eighth Theater, the Kyoto troops broadcast non-stop using loudspeakers.
Lin Hao found that the light and shadow were very blurry, and its soul aura looked very powerful.
"Who says otherwise? Fortunately, we brought a lot of goblin cannons. The top of the rock formation is also within the range of the fourth-level superpower gun. As a result, the Wing Tribe people and the flying knights are not much of a threat. Otherwise, it is hard to say how the battle will turn out."
Ren Weimin frowned and stared at the entire battlefield with a pair of tiger eyes.
Amidst the popping sound, a large area of ​​lawn was splashed with earth and rocks, and dense potholes appeared one after another.
He was holding tea and sitting in the back hall, but his thoughts suddenly flew to the layout of Dongyang City. He found that although Dongyang City was not big and there was only one street, it was neatly laid out. The official offices were separated from ordinary people's residences and shops, and the conference hall was used as the central axis to form a symmetrical layout.
It's beyond the scope of God's perspective, and it's beyond the scope of your manually controlled clones. Even the special soldiers guarding you officers are equipped with multiple anti-stealth devices.
It would be impossible to eavesdrop on the details of the plans discussed at subsequent meetings using ordinary means.
Yao Ling cried intermittently. She was no longer a vampire. Her body couldn't bear this roughness. It hurt, it really hurt. She hated the ghost master and one day she would kill him with her own hands.
"Bang"
The sound was like an explosion in the valley. As the sound exploded, hundreds of people jumped into the sky together, and then landed accurately on the Guards brigade like cannonballs. The heavy blows were hit one after another, and they jumped up one after another.
Before Yunze could return it to her, Qingrang had already stood up and walked out. Yunze held the golden hairpin in his hand and understood what she meant. She entrusted him with such a precious thing. She didn't look back at him because she hoped that he would live to see her again no matter what.
After a while, the martial arts students looked at each other and couldn't stop smiling. Their vigilance and hostility faded away, leaving only pure fighting spirit.
After the great god Pangu's soul had dispersed for a long time, everyone slowly came back to their senses.
The power of magic is relatively simple. Understanding the body and mind from the inside seems mysterious, but it is actually a combination of theory and practice.
This is why Zuo Yin always talks about experiments and slice studies.
"Brother, why don't you want me to go to Yeyin so much? After all, that is Brother Seventh's restaurant."
Compared to other places, at least there was someone she could trust and rely on.
She knew very well that those missing people were dead and could never be found again.
War is like a seesaw. If one side is high, the other side will be low.
One side is happy, while the other side is unhappy.
